desc: Reduce 400 numbers to squares of integers with exactly two distinct prime factors.

Implement Python solution: read all queries, compute R=isqrt(max query), build a bytearray distinct-prime-factor-count sieve up to R, collect all squares i*i where count[i]==2, then for each query output the largest collected square <= A using bisect_right.
Run sample and edge-case tests (36, 404, 60, 10^12, 123456789, random small brute force) and fix any failures.
